moment_table.fiducial: 66 < m_ll < 116 GeV, pT_l > 27 GeV, |eta_l| < 2.5, Born-level leptons (ATLAS 13 TeV)

conventions.moments: pooled over the runs: the ratio of the summed numerator and denominator accumulators; stat = run-to-run scatter of the per-run ratio / sqrt(n_runs); scale = half-range over the seven scales
conventions.sigma_fid: the mean over the runs of the per-run cross section
conventions.window_rate: the mean over the runs of the per-run window rate <w>/sigma_fid, as in the paper's solves; stat = run-to-run scatter / sqrt(n_runs); scale = half-range over the seven scales of that mean

provenance.nnlojet: NNLOJET v1.0.2 with the patch in nnlojet_patch/ (event-level moment accumulators)
